subject: general
question: The vertices of a triangle are A(4,−6), B(3,−2) and C(5,2). Find the area of the triangle formed by these points.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use determinant formula:

Area = (1/2) |x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|

= (1/2) |4(−2 − 2) + 3(2 − (−6)) + 5(−6 − (−2))|

= (1/2) |4(−4) + 3(8) + 5(−4)| = (1/2) |−16 + 24 − 20|

= (1/2) × 12 = 6

**∴ Answer = 6 sq units**
